_doc: The zones' colours as the overlay shows them. One hue a use, by the genre's convention: residential, commercial and industrial zones are green, blue and yellow, "as in SimCity" (tvtropes.org, VideoGame/CitiesSkylines); the density is told by the tone of that hue, the low density a lighter tint and the high a darker shade ("Light Green- low density housing, Dark Green- high density housing", a players' post on the zones of Cities: Skylines, forum.paradoxplaza.com; read 2026-11-14). With one colour for the three densities the player could not tell on the ground which density he had painted (doc/work/zones-photos.md, photos 01 and 02).
